findings.failure_path: a credentialed URL such as https://user:pass@proxy:8080 echoed by a connect error survives redaction, because only the query string is stripped and userinfo matches no key=value, sk-, Bearer or eyJ rule, landing a credential-shaped value in the committed receipt
findings.smallest_fix: strip userinfo in the URL pass, e.g. re.sub(r"(https?://)[^\s/@:]+:[^\s/@]*@", r"\1", text) before the query-string sub

findings.failure_path: a double-quoted assignment value containing spaces (token="abc def") is redacted only up to the first space since the value class [^\s,;]+ stops there, leaking the remainder of the credential into the diagnostic
findings.smallest_fix: let the assignment rule consume quoted values: ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)\s*=\s*("[^"]*"|[^\s,;]+)
